objective: Recover vanished native Wall ad slots after failure; avoid serial 12-16-second NativeAd timeouts when live inventory repeatedly stalls; preserve publisher revenue protections, SDK-visible impressions, and current placements.
productionBaselineEvidence: Live read-only private.buklod_ad_operational_events on 2026-11-17 Asia/Manila: public_wall_feed 45 Native requests, 22 Native timeouts, 1 Native load, 6 banner fallback requests, 4 banner no-fill, 1 banner load; public_wall_entry 26 Native requests and 6 Native timeouts. GitHub main ac48fcee3236470162d5284ece7bca9aed84faf3 has Wall ad slots wired. Exact currently served production OTA asset, device rendering, and AdMob publisher account fill metrics not verified; no RC, EAS OTA, or production claim.
chosenApproach: Keep a measurable 8px viewport probe instead of returning null after native inline banner fallback fails; allow the existing 2-minute cooldown and focus/viewability recovery to fire. Track only real NativeAd SDK failure/timeout per placement; following two failures, direct subsequent eligible new requests to one existing banner fallback for five minutes, respecting reserveBuklodPassiveAdRequest and all existing safety gates. Reset transient failure preference on a successful NativeAd load.
selectionRationale: Prioritize actual loaded inventory and prevent collapsed row viewability deadlock; do not fabricate fill, impressions, requests, or publisher earnings. Avoid native dependency, ad unit, production EAS env, DB schema or frequency changes.
alternativeApproaches: Disable NativeAd universally: rejected because it discards working creatives and video capable inventory.
Remove AdMob cooldown or continuously retry no-fill: rejected because it creates request inflation and Google policy risk.
Immediately ship unverified production OTA: rejected; consolidated DEV→verified RC→Production release gates remain mandatory.
preserveBehaviors: Keep existing production AdMob app and unit IDs, flags, consent, and test/live mode selection.
Preserve Wall first-view, in-feed, comments, companion, Home, Profile, Connect, Cluster, Reels, paid sponsored campaigns and current Android ad cadence.
NativeAdView still only renders when on-screen; no offscreen view, hidden refresh, fake impressions or instant retry loop.
Keep Expo runtime 1.3.2, app package, native SDK, production channel, and app data/privacy intact.
Keep every wall/Connect media, task, points, community, Kingdom and Finance feature outside this scope unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: Failed inline banners retain a compact, non-clickable viewport probe eligible for later cooldown recovery; no collapsed giant blank frame.
After two NativeAd timeouts or rejected loads on one placement, an eligible new placement uses its existing banner before another native request for at most five minutes.
Banner-first on degraded NativeAd respects existing passive request reservation, focus, consent, route and measured visibility.
NativeAd successful load clears transient preference; late Native responses remain destroyed and cannot overwrite fallback.
Existing ad placement wiring, SDK impression callbacks, ad-frequency limits, and Finance isolation remain intact.
TypeScript, focused regressions and required PR CI must pass before any merge; verified RC, frozen OTA and served bundle validation required before production.
